jobs.caption: Foley sound effect, one single short event then silence: a stiff playing card flipped over on a stone table, a crisp paper snap and a soft tap, dry close-miked, no music, no melody, no drums, no reverb.

Cinematic sound effect, one single event then silence: a heavy magical card turning slowly through the air, a deep airy whoosh with a soft arcane shimmer that swells and lands, no music, no melody, no drums.

Magical sound effect, one single event then silence: an enchanted card face is revealed, a bright glassy bell chime with a sparkling arcane shimmer tail that fades out, no music, no drums, no melody line.
Game sound effect, one single event then silence: two matching cards found, a satisfying two-note ascending bell chime with a warm golden shimmer, short, clean, no music, no drums.

Game sound effect, one single event then silence: a cluster of magic cards shatter and burst apart, a deep punchy impact with a crumbling debris crackle and a cascade of glittering high sparkles scattering away, no music, no drums, no melody.

Short victory sting, one single phrase then silence: a triumphant three-note brass and choir fanfare in a stone cathedral, resolving on a bright major chord with a long reverb tail, cinematic, no drums.

Cinematic sound effect, one single event: a two-second rising tension riser, a whooshing string tremolo and reversed cymbal crescendo climbing upward and stopping dead at the top, no drums, no melody.

Cinematic sound effect, one single event then silence: a massive deep sub-bass boom like a giant stone door slamming shut in a cathedral, with a dark low reverb tail decaying slowly, no music, no drums, no melody.
